resources.name: Innate Sorcery
resources.description:
See the Innate Sorcery feature for costs, use, and recovery. An event in your past left an indelible mark on you, infusing you with simmering magic. As a Bonus Action, you can unleash that magic for 1 minute, during which you gain the following benefits:

The spell save DC of your Sorcerer spells increases by 1.
You have Advantage on the attack rolls of Sorcerer spells you cast.
You can use this feature twice, and you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a Long Rest.
resources.maximum_rule: See the feature and level table; resolve structured maximum and recovery rules before implementation.

resources.name: Font of Mutation
resources.description:
See the Font of Magic feature for costs, use, and recovery. You can tap into the wellspring of magic within yourself. This wellspring is represented by Sorcery Points, which allow you to create a variety of magical effects.

You have 2 Sorcery Points, and you gain more as you reach higher levels, as shown in the Sorcery Points column of the Sorcerer Features table. You can’t have more Sorcery Points than the number shown in the table for your level. You regain all expended Sorcery Points when you finish a Long Rest.

You can use your Sorcery Points to fuel the options below, along with other features, such as Metamagic, that use those points.

Converting Spell Slots to Sorcery Points. You can expend a spell slot to gain a number of Sorcery Points equal to the slot’s level (no action required).

Creating Spell Slots. As a Bonus Action, you can transform unexpended Sorcery Points into one spell slot. The Creating Spell Slots table shows the cost of creating a spell slot of a given level, and it lists the minimum Sorcerer level you must be to create a slot. You can create a spell slot no higher than level 5.

Any spell slot you create with this feature vanishes when you finish a Long Rest.

Creating Spell Slots
Spell Slot Level	Sorcery Point Cost	Min. Sorcerer Level
1	2	2
2	3	3
3	5	5
4	6	7
5	7	9

features.name: Spellcasting: Innate Mutation (Spellcasting)
features.description:
Drawing from your innate magic, you can cast spells. See “Spells” for the rules on spellcasting. The information below details how you use those rules with Sorcerer spells, which appear in the Sorcerer spell list later in the class’s description.

Cantrips. You know four Sorcerer cantrips of your choice. Light, Prestidigitation, Shocking Grasp, and Sorcerous Burst are recommended. Whenever you gain a Sorcerer level, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Sorcerer cantrip of your choice.

When you reach Sorcerer levels 4 and 10, you learn another Sorcerer cantrip of your choice, as shown in the Cantrips column of the Sorcerer Features table.

Spell Slots. The Sorcerer Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

Prepared Spells of Level 1+. You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose two level 1 Sorcerer spells. Burning Hands and Detect Magic are recommended.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Sorcerer levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Sorcerer Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Sorcerer spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the Sorcerer Features table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you’re a level 3 Sorcerer, your list of prepared spells can include six Sorcerer spells of level 1 or 2 in any combination.

If another Sorcerer feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don’t count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Sorcerer spells for you.

Changing Your Prepared Spells. Whenever you gain a Sorcerer level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Sorcerer spell for which you have spell slots.

Spellcasting Ability. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for your Sorcerer spells.

Spellcasting Focus. You can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus for your Sorcerer spells.

features.name: Spellcasting Ability
features.description: Charisma is your spellcasting ability. Your spell save DC is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier, and your spell attack modifier is your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Known Spells and Spell Slots
features.description: You know four cantrips and two 1st-level Sorcerer spells at 1st level. Your cantrips known increase to five at level 4 and six at level 10; your spells known increase by level according to the 2014 Sorcerer table, to a maximum of 15. When you gain a level in this class, you can replace one Sorcerer spell you know with another Sorcerer spell of a level for which you have slots. You regain all expended spell slots after a long rest. Spell-slot progression follows the 2014 Sorcerer table.

reskin_reference.name: 2. Font of Mutation (Font of Magic - Level 2)

features.name: Mutation Points
features.description: You gain 2 mutation points at 2nd level and one more at each Awakened Mutant level thereafter. You regain all expended points when you finish a long rest, and cannot hold more than your class-level maximum. These points fuel Metamagic and other features.

features.name: Flexible Casting
features.description: As a bonus action, you can spend mutation points to create a spell slot: 1st level costs 2 points, 2nd costs 3, 3rd costs 5, 4th costs 6, and 5th costs 7. You cannot create a slot above 5th level; created slots vanish after a long rest. As a bonus action, you can also expend a spell slot to gain mutation points equal to its level.

features.name: Metamagic
features.description:
Because your magic flows from within, you can alter your spells to suit your needs; you gain two Metamagic options of your choice from “Metamagic Options” later in this class’s description. You use the chosen options to temporarily modify spells you cast. To use an option, you must spend the number of Sorcery Points that it costs.

You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it unless otherwise noted in one of those options.

Whenever you gain a Sorcerer level, you can replace one of your Metamagic options with one you don’t know. You gain two more options at Sorcerer level 10 and two more at Sorcerer level 17.

features.name: Arcane Apotheosis
features.description: While your Innate Sorcery feature is active, you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without spending Sorcery Points on it.

features.name: Class progression values

subclasses.name: Sector 17 Bio-Mutant
subclasses.description: An experimental mutation connects the mind to alien signals and reshapes the body. Reskin of Aberrant Sorcery; older guide mechanics are thematic only.

resources.name: Spatial Collapse
resources.description: Use the level 18 teleport and implosion once; the use can also be restored by spending 5 mutation points without an action.
resources.maximum_rule: One use at class level 18; regain it on a long rest or restore it by spending 5 mutation points.

features.name: Ghost Signal Spells (Psionic Spells)
features.description: Arms of Hadar, Calm Emotions, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, and the Mind Sliver cantrip are always prepared as Awakened Mutant spells. They use Charisma; the level 1+ spells do not count against the class's prepared-spell limit. The cantrip is separately granted, not a selection from the class cantrip total.

features.name: Neural Link (Telepathic Speech)
features.description: As a bonus action, link with one creature you can see within 30 feet. You can communicate telepathically while within a number of miles equal to your Charisma modifier, minimum 1 mile; each participant must mentally use a language the other understands. The link lasts for minutes equal to your Awakened Mutant level, ending early if you form a link with another creature.

features.name: Ghost Signal Spells
features.description: Hunger of Hadar and Sending become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings.

features.name: Direct Neural Casting (Psionic Sorcery)
features.description: Cast a level 1 or higher spell granted by Ghost Signal Spells using a spell slot normally or mutation points equal to its spell level. When using points, the spell needs no verbal or somatic components and no material components unless they are consumed or have a specified cost.

features.name: Cognitive Firewall (Psychic Defenses)
features.description: You have resistance to psychic damage and advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed or frightened conditions.

levels.notes: Mutation points are the base class's Sorcery Points, not a separate pool.

features.name: Ghost Signal Spells
features.description: Evard's Black Tentacles and Summon Aberration become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings. The existing spell mapping uses the shorter name Black Tentacles for Evard's Black Tentacles.

features.name: Ghost Signal Spells
features.description: Rary's Telepathic Bond and Telekinesis become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings. The existing spell mapping uses the shorter name Telepathic Bond for Rary's Telepathic Bond.

features.name: Adaptive Mutation (Revelation in Flesh)
features.description: As a bonus action, spend one or more mutation points to alter your body for 10 minutes, choosing one benefit per point spent. Aquatic Adaptation: swim speed twice your speed and breathe underwater. Glistening Flight: fly speed equal to your speed and hover. See the Invisible: see invisible creatures within 60 feet that are not behind total cover. Wormlike Movement: your body and worn or carried equipment fit through spaces as narrow as 1 inch; spend 5 feet of movement to escape nonmagical restraints or the grappled condition. Benefits last until the alteration ends.

choices.name: Choose mutation benefits when activated
choices.eligibility_rule: Choose one benefit per mutation point spent on this activation. The source does not specify whether a benefit may be chosen more than once; review before automation.
choices.selection_effect: Apply the chosen benefits for 10 minutes; do not save as a permanent level-up choice.

features.name: Spatial Collapse (Warping Implosion)
features.description: As a Magic action, teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet. Immediately after you disappear, every creature within 30 feet of your former space makes a Strength save against your spell save DC. On failure it takes 3d10 force damage and is pulled straight toward your former space, ending in an unoccupied space as close to it as possible; on success it takes half damage only. Once used, regain the use on a long rest or restore it by spending 5 mutation points without an action.

subclasses.name: KAMI Synthetic Soul Vessel
subclasses.description: Orderly synthetic instincts and arcane computation regulate the mutant's powers. Reskin of Clockwork Sorcery; older guide mechanics are thematic only.

resources.name: Signal Equalizer
resources.description: Spend one use to cancel advantage and disadvantage on an eligible d20 roll.
resources.maximum_rule: Charisma modifier uses, minimum 1, beginning at class level 3; regain all uses on a long rest.

resources.name: Perfect Calibration
resources.description: Activate the level 14 trance; spending 5 mutation points without an action restores the use.
resources.maximum_rule: One use at class level 14; regain it on a long rest or restore it by spending 5 mutation points.

resources.name: Calibration Cascade
resources.description: Activate the level 18 cascade; spending 7 mutation points without an action restores the use.
resources.maximum_rule: One use at class level 18; regain it on a long rest or restore it by spending 7 mutation points.

features.name: Synthetic Soul Spells (Clockwork Spells)
features.description: Aid, Alarm, Lesser Restoration, and Protection from Evil and Good are always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, use Charisma, and do not count against the class prepared-spell limit. Choose or randomly determine a visible or audible manifestation of order that appears when casting your Awakened Mutant spells.

choices.name: Choose or roll an order manifestation
allowed_options: Focus becomes a Tiny clockwork mechanism
choices.eligibility_rule: Choose one or roll a d6; this is a cosmetic manifestation while casting Awakened Mutant spells.
choices.selection_effect: Record the manifestation; it grants no additional mechanical effect.

features.name: Signal Equalizer (Restore Balance)
features.description: When a creature you can see within 60 feet is about to roll a d20 with advantage or disadvantage, use your reaction to prevent both advantage and disadvantage affecting that roll. Use this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, minimum once; regain all uses on a long rest.

features.name: Synthetic Soul Spells
features.description: Dispel Magic and Protection from Energy become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings.

features.name: Bulwark of Law (Bastion of Law)
features.description: As a Magic action, spend 1 to 5 mutation points to ward yourself or a creature you can see within 30 feet. The ward holds one d8 per point spent. When the warded creature takes damage, it can spend any number of those dice, roll them, and reduce the damage by their total. The ward lasts until you finish a long rest or use this feature again.

levels.notes: Ward dice and mutation points require separate tracking; spending dice does not spend additional mutation points.

features.name: Synthetic Soul Spells
features.description: Freedom of Movement and Summon Construct become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings.

features.name: Synthetic Soul Spells
features.description: Greater Restoration and Wall of Force become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings.

features.name: Perfect Calibration (Trance of Order)
features.description: As a bonus action, enter a 1-minute trance. Attack rolls against you cannot benefit from advantage, and you may treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower on your D20 Tests as a 10. Once used, regain the use on a long rest or restore it by spending 5 mutation points without an action.

features.name: Calibration Cascade (Clockwork Cavalcade)
features.description: As a Magic action, summon intangible, invulnerable spirits resembling modrons or other constructs of your choice in a 30-foot cube originating from you. Before vanishing, they distribute up to 100 hit points among any chosen creatures in the cube, repair damaged objects entirely inside it, and end every spell of level 6 or lower on chosen creatures and objects in it. Once used, regain the use on a long rest or restore it by spending 7 mutation points without an action.

subclasses.name: Dragon-Blood Replicant
subclasses.description: A draconic genome splice manifests as plated skin, elemental energy, and bioengineered wings. Reskin of Draconic Sorcery; older guide mechanics are thematic only.

resources.name: Grafted Wings
resources.description: Manifest wings at level 14; spending 3 mutation points without an action restores the use.
resources.maximum_rule: One use at class level 14; regain it on a long rest or restore it by spending 3 mutation points.

resources.name: Wyrm Companion
resources.description: Cast Summon Dragon once without a spell slot.
resources.maximum_rule: One free casting at class level 18; regain it on a long rest.

features.name: Dermal Plating (Draconic Resilience)
features.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 3 now and by 1 for each later Awakened Mutant level. While not wearing armor, your base AC is 10 plus your Dexterity modifier plus your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Wyrm Genome Spells (Draconic Spells)
features.description: Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, and Dragon's Breath are always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, use Charisma, and do not count against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: The hit point increase uses Awakened Mutant class level, not total character level.

features.name: Wyrm Genome Spells
features.description: Fear and Fly become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings.

features.name: Genome Elemental Affinity
features.description: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage. You have resistance to the chosen type. When you cast a spell that deals that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of the spell.

choices.name: Choose an elemental affinity
choices.eligibility_rule: Choose one listed damage type when gaining this feature; no replacement rule is specified.
choices.selection_effect: Record the selected damage type, its resistance, and the matching spell damage bonus.

features.name: Wyrm Genome Spells
features.description: Arcane Eye and Charm Monster become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings.

features.name: Wyrm Genome Spells
features.description: Legend Lore and Summon Dragon become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings.

features.name: Grafted Wings (Dragon Wings)
features.description: As a bonus action, manifest wings for 1 hour or until dismissed without an action; you have a fly speed of 60 feet while they last. Once used, regain the use on a long rest or restore it by spending 3 mutation points without an action.

features.name: Wyrm Companion (Dragon Companion)
features.description: You can cast Summon Dragon without a material component, and once without a spell slot per long rest. Whenever you start casting it, you can remove its concentration requirement; for that casting its duration becomes 1 minute.

levels.notes: Summon Dragon is already always prepared from level 9; the free casting is a separate level 18 benefit.

subclasses.name: Shadow Signal Mutant
subclasses.description: Exposure to a dark ghost signal lets a mutant move through shadows and call shadow beasts. Reskin of Shadow Sorcery.

resources.name: Grave-Signal Override
resources.description: After successfully using the level 3 survival save, the benefit cannot be used again until a long rest; failed saves do not expend the successful-use allowance.
resources.maximum_rule: One successful use at class level 3; regain it on a long rest.

resources.name: Umbral Signal Form
resources.description: Adopt the level 18 form when using Innate Sorcery; spending 6 mutation points without an action restores the use.
resources.maximum_rule: One use at class level 18; regain it on a long rest or restore it by spending 6 mutation points.

features.name: Shadow Signal Spells (Shadow Spells)
features.description: Bane, Darkness, Inflict Wounds, and Pass Without Trace are always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, use Charisma, and do not count against the class prepared-spell limit.

features.name: Ghost Optics and Grave-Signal Override (Power of Shadow)
features.description: You have darkvision to 120 feet and blindsight to 10 feet; you can see normally through darkness created by a spell you cast. If damage would reduce you to 0 hit points without killing you outright, you can make a Charisma saving throw against DC 5 plus the damage taken. On success, your hit points instead become your Charisma modifier plus your Awakened Mutant level. After a successful save, you cannot use this benefit again until a long rest.

levels.notes: The source does not specify a minimum for the hit points after a successful survival save; review before automation.

features.name: Shadow Signal Spells
features.description: Hunger of Hadar and Nondetection become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings.

features.name: Ghost Hound Protocol (Beasts of Ill Omen)
features.description: Spend 3 mutation points to cast Summon Beast as a bonus action without a spell slot, preparation, or material components. The beast appears to be made of shadow; enemies within 5 feet of it have disadvantage on saves against spells you cast. Whenever you cast the spell, you can remove its concentration requirement; if you do, its duration becomes 1 minute and it ends early if you cast the spell again.

levels.notes: The source does not specify the spell level for the point-funded casting; review before automation.

features.name: Shadow Signal Spells
features.description: Greater Invisibility and Phantasmal Killer become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings.

features.name: Shadow Signal Spells
features.description: Contagion and Creation become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings.

features.name: Dark-Signal Jump (Shadow Walk)
features.description: While in dim light or darkness, use a bonus action to teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

features.name: Umbral Signal Form (Umbral Form)
features.description: When you use Innate Sorcery, adopt a shadow form lasting while that use is active or until you end the form without an action. You move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain, taking 1d10 force damage if you end your turn inside one. You resist all damage except force and radiant. Once used, regain the use on a long rest or restore it by spending 6 mutation points without an action.

subclasses.name: Spellfire Reactor Mutant
subclasses.description: An unstable arcane reactor in the mutant's body absorbs hostile magic and releases healing or destructive spellfire. Reskin of Spellfire Sorcery.

resources.name: Reactor Crown
resources.description: Alter Innate Sorcery at level 18; spending 5 mutation points without an action restores the use.
resources.maximum_rule: One use at class level 18; regain it on a long rest or restore it by spending 5 mutation points.

features.name: Reactor Burst (Spellfire Burst)
features.description: Once per turn, when you spend at least 1 mutation point as part of a Magic action or bonus action on your turn, choose one effect. Bolstering Flames gives you or a creature you can see within 30 feet temporary hit points equal to 1d4 plus your Charisma modifier. Radiant Fire deals 1d4 fire or radiant damage, your choice, to one creature you can see within 30 feet.

features.name: Reactor Spells (Spellfire Spells)
features.description: Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, and Scorching Ray are always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, use Charisma, and do not count against the class prepared-spell limit.

features.name: Reactor Spells
features.description: Aura of Vitality and Dispel Magic become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings.

features.name: Hostile Code Absorption (Absorb Spells)
features.description: Counterspell is always prepared as an Awakened Mutant spell, uses Charisma, and does not count against the class prepared-spell limit. Whenever a target fails its saving throw against a Counterspell you cast, regain 1d4 mutation points, subject to your normal point maximum.

levels.notes: Counterspell is not a free casting; recovery uses the base mutation-point pool.

features.name: Reactor Spells
features.description: Fire Shield and Wall of Fire become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings.

features.name: Reactor Spells
features.description: Greater Restoration and Flame Strike become always prepared Awakened Mutant spells, using Charisma and not counting against the class prepared-spell limit.

levels.notes: Fixed spell grants, not choices or free castings.

features.name: Honed Reactor Burst (Honed Spellfire)
features.description: Add your Awakened Mutant level to the temporary hit points from Bolstering Flames. Radiant Fire's damage die increases from 1d4 to 1d8.

features.name: Reactor Crown (Crown of Spellfire)
features.description: When you use Innate Sorcery, alter that use to gain the following while it remains active: once per turn when hit by an attack roll, expend up to your Charisma modifier Hit Point Dice (minimum maximum 1), roll them, and reduce the attack's damage by their total; gain a fly speed of 60 feet and hover; and when a spell or magical effect offers a save for half damage, take no damage on a success and half on a failure, unless incapacitated. Once used, regain the use on a long rest or restore it by spending 5 mutation points without an action.

subclasses.name: Wild Signal Mutant
subclasses.description: A chaotic ghost signal destabilizes the mutant's magic, producing unpredictable surges. Reskin of Wild Magic Sorcery.

resources.name: Chaos Bias
resources.description: Gain advantage on one D20 Test before rolling; regain the use by casting an Awakened Mutant spell with a spell slot or finishing a long rest.
resources.maximum_rule: One use at class level 3; the qualifying spell cast before a long rest also triggers a surge-table roll.

resources.name: Directed Signal Surge
resources.description: Select an eligible surge effect after a qualifying spell cast.
resources.maximum_rule: One use at class level 18; regain it on a long rest.

features.name: Wild Signal Surge (Wild Magic Surge)
features.description: Once per turn, immediately after casting an Awakened Mutant spell with a spell slot, you can roll 1d20; on a 20, roll on the surge table below. A spell produced by a surge cannot be modified by your Metamagic. The numbered outcomes below preserve the supplied table; any spell effect uses that spell's own rules except where the outcome says otherwise.

surge_table.effect: For 1 minute, roll on this table at the start of each of your turns; ignore this result on those subsequent rolls.

A friendly creature appears in a random unoccupied space within 60 feet, controlled by the DM, and disappears after 1 minute. Roll 1d4: 1 Modron Duodrone, 2 Flumph, 3 Modron Monodrone, 4 Unicorn; use the relevant stat block.
For 1 minute, regain 5 hit points at the start of each of your turns.
Creatures have disadvantage on saves against the next spell you cast within 1 minute that requires a saving throw.

Roll 1d8 for an effect lasting 1 minute unless noted: 1 faint music audible only to you and creatures within 5 feet; 2 your size increases one category; 3 a feather beard remains until a sneeze makes the feathers explode and vanish; 4 you must shout when speaking; 5 illusory butterflies flutter within 10 feet; 6 a forehead eye gives advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks; 7 pink bubbles emerge when you speak; 8 blue skin for 24 hours or until Remove Curse ends it.
For 1 minute, your spells with an action casting time instead have a bonus action casting time.
Travel to the Astral Plane until the end of your next turn, then return to your former space or its nearest unoccupied space.
For the next spell you cast within 1 minute that deals damage, use the maximum value of each damage die instead of rolling it.
You have resistance to all damage for 1 minute.
Become a potted plant until the start of your next turn. While a plant, you are incapacitated and vulnerable to all damage; at 0 hit points the pot breaks and your form reverts.
For 1 minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns.
You and up to three creatures you choose within 30 feet are invisible for 1 minute. A creature's invisibility ends immediately after it makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
For 1 minute a spectral shield grants you +2 AC and immunity to Magic Missile.
You can take one extra action on this turn.

Cast a random spell; if it normally requires concentration, it instead lasts its full duration without concentration. Roll 1d10: 1 Confusion; 2 Fireball; 3 Fog Cloud; 4 Fly on a random creature within 60 feet; 5 Grease; 6 Levitate on yourself; 7 Magic Missile at level 5; 8 Mirror Image; 9 Polymorph on yourself, becoming a Goat on a failed save; 10 See Invisibility.
For 1 minute, flammable nonmagical objects you touch that are not worn or carried by another creature ignite, take 1d4 fire damage, and burn.
If you die within 1 hour, immediately revive as if by Reincarnate.
You are frightened until the end of your next turn; the DM determines the source.
Teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
A random creature within 60 feet is poisoned for 1d4 hours.
Emit bright light in a 30-foot radius for 1 minute; creatures ending their turn within 5 feet are blinded until the end of their next turn.
Up to three creatures of your choice you can see within 30 feet take 1d10 necrotic damage; you regain hit points equal to the total necrotic damage dealt.
Up to three creatures of your choice you can see within 30 feet take 4d10 lightning damage.
You and every creature within 30 feet have vulnerability to piercing damage for 1 minute.

Roll 1d6: 1 regain 2d10 hit points; 2 one chosen ally within 300 feet regains 2d10 hit points; 3 regain your lowest-level expended spell slot; 4 one chosen ally within 300 feet regains their lowest-level expended spell slot; 5 regain all expended mutation points; 6 all effects from row 17-20 affect you simultaneously.

features.name: Chaos Bias (Tides of Chaos)
features.description: Before rolling a D20 Test, give yourself advantage on it. You cannot use this again until you cast an Awakened Mutant spell with a spell slot or finish a long rest. If you cast such a spell before finishing a long rest, automatically roll on the Wild Signal Surge table.

levels.notes: Tides of Chaos's automatic surge is distinct from the optional d20 check of Wild Magic Surge; the source does not specify how simultaneous triggers interact.

features.name: Probability Glitch (Bend Luck)
features.description: Immediately after another creature you can see rolls the d20 for a D20 Test, use your reaction and spend 1 mutation point to roll 1d4 and add or subtract the result from that d20 roll, your choice.

features.name: Signal Steering (Controlled Chaos)
features.description: Whenever you roll on the Wild Signal Surge table, you can roll twice and choose which result to use.

features.name: Directed Signal Surge (Tamed Surge)
features.description: Immediately after casting an Awakened Mutant spell with a spell slot, choose an effect from the Wild Signal Surge table instead of rolling on it. You may choose any row except 97-00; if that effect calls for a roll, make it. Once used, regain this feature on a long rest.

choices.name: Choose a surge effect when used
choices.allowed_options: Any Wild Signal Surge table row except 97-00.
choices.eligibility_rule: Choose after a qualifying spell cast; make any rolls required by the chosen outcome.
choices.selection_effect: Apply the chosen effect; this is not a permanent level-up selection.

source_notes: Rules basis: _reference/classes/Sorcerer.md, a 2024-style source. Review compatibility with the earlier 2014 multiclass design.
Class progression and mechanics use the original reference; older reskin mechanics may differ and are thematic reference only, not additional grants.
The worksheet schema is not supported by the app. Levels remain unfilled pending rules and choice review; null means unresolved or not applicable as described.
Six origins are authored from developernotes/classes/Sorcerer/subclasses. Their features, spell grants, choices, resources, and surge table are draft data and are not applied by the app.
Mutation points refer to the base class Sorcery Points pool. Spell grant names use original source names pending matching to the spell data; the guide's older origin rules are not additional grants.
Reskin inspiration: classes/Awakened Mutant.json. Names may be adapted where source mechanics have changed.
